run_summary_stats_pipeline: run the summary stats pipeline on a JSONL dataset with configurable sample rate and top-k grouping
create_slurm_pipeline_executor: create a SlurmPipelineExecutor that runs a Datatrove pipeline on a Slurm cluster with configurable tasks and resources
build_stats_pipeline: build a Datatrove pipeline with JsonlReader, SamplerFilter, WordStats, LineStats, and DocStats stages
run_stats_merger: run a StatsMerger to combine per-task statistics from a distributed Datatrove pipeline into aggregated results
configure_top_k_stats: configure TopKConfig to track the top-k groups by fqdn and suffix for word, line, and document statistics
